convert_wan_transformer_to_diffusers: convert a Wan T2V 14B transformer model from original format to diffusers safetensors format
convert_wan_high_noise_model: convert the wan high_noise_model transformer to diffusers format and save to output transformer directory
convert_wan_low_noise_model: convert the wan low_noise_model transformer to diffusers format and save to output transformer_2 directory
load_wan_sharded_safetensors: load sharded safetensors model files from a directory into a single state dictionary
get_wan_transformer_rename_mapping: get the transformer key rename mapping dictionary for a specified wan model type
